name: Winter Squash Carbonara

ingredients.name: minced fresh flat-leaf parsley and chives

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 425°F. In a large bowl, toss sliced squash with 2 tablespoons olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Arrange in even layers on 2 rimmed baking sheets and roast until browned and tender, about 45 minutes. Let cool slightly.

Meanwhile, in a skillet, combine pork with 1 tablespoon olive oil and thyme, if using, and cook over medium heat, stirring, until pork is crisp and fat has rendered, about 7 minutes. Remove from heat and discard thyme. Stir in red wine vinegar, remaining 3 tablespoons olive oil, and parsley and chives. Keep vinaigrette warm.

Using a thin metal spatula, lift squash from baking sheets. Arrange on a serving platter. Spoon warm vinaigrette on top. Garnish with crumbled egg yolks and grated cheese and grate more fresh black pepper on top. Serve.

schema_metadata.keywords: carbonara, carbonara recipe, winter squash, winter squash recipes

description: This sweet roasted squash side dish is topped with all the components of a classic carbonara—egg, crispy pork, grated cheeses, and black pepper—but presented very differently from the famed Roman sauce.
notes:
Optional or for serving: 4 sprigs fresh thyme (optional); Grated Pecorino Romano and/or Parmigiano-Reggiano, for garnish

Optional substitutions: red-skinned kabocha squash → green-skinned kabocha squash
author: Daniel Gritzer
